title: Towards Fair and Efficient De-identification: Quantifying the Efficiency and Generalizability of De-identification Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating de-identification model performance (recall and precision) by substituting US English identifiers in clinical notes with synthetically generated identifiers from diverse language and cultural variants (e.g., Mandarin, Spanish, Hindi, French, Bengali, and regional English) using the Faker library.
Measuring and comparing the recall of de-identification models separately for explicitly masculine and feminine names across multiple languages to assess performance disparities.
